```{r}
library(flashier.utils)
set.seed(4)
X <- matrix(rexp(120),20,6,dimnames=list(paste0("s",1:20),paste0("f",1:6)))
fit <- fit_nonnegative_ebmf(X,"rows",max_factors=2,seed=1,verbose=0,feature_scale="intensity")
view <- standardize_factors(fit)
metadata <- data.frame(sample=rownames(X),group=rep(c("A","B"),each=10),donor=paste0("d",1:20))
contrast <- compare_factor_groups(view,metadata,"group",c("A","B"),unit_col="donor")
contrast$factor_contrast
observed <- data.frame(feature=colnames(X),estimate=colMeans(X[1:10,])-colMeans(X[11:20,]),contrast="A - B")
validate_backprojection(contrast$feature_contrast,observed,feature_scale="intensity")$metrics
```

Group A minus B uses identical per-observation weights for direct and represented
effects. The represented effect can omit residual signatures. Prediction R squared
can be negative. These descriptive contrasts have no p-values. No count
normalization, nonlinear inversion or log2 conversion is performed.
